mapping: pilot/counselor-shiny/app.R renders the exception overview and curriculum selected by explicit component IDs. It displays the official study guide link and only explicit audience notes. No UCR concepts, course descriptions or alignment rows are selected.

audience.programmeDescription: Leiden’s Middle Eastern Studies bachelor examines the history, societies, religions, languages and politics of the region. This example follows Modern Middle East Studies with Arabic.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The curriculum comparison is under review. The published course list repeats a required course across two years.

curriculum.routeLabel: Modern Middle East Studies with Arabic
curriculum.limitation: The 175 EC shown count History of Central Asia & Afghanistan once. Leiden’s guide lists it in years two and three. The remaining 5 EC for year three still need confirmation.

componentNotes.curr-5531vaty: One of two published choices for the second-year elective.
componentNotes.curr-5853vewy: Entry normally requires completion of year one and 55 EC from year two.
componentNotes.curr-component-26: The first semester of year three is reserved for approved elective study.

linkChecks.result: Official study-guide page returned its application shell; the page’s annual product was checked directly. The official regulations PDF and index were inspected through indexed copies.

finding: The 26 titles and credit labels correspond to distinct catalogue entries. Arabic progression, the restricted elective, thesis threshold and 30 EC elective block are explicit. The source limitation gives the reason for the missing 5 EC and the overview sets expectations. Internal case evidence and the internal proposal are outside this view.
